Personal Data Protection Act 2012

An Act to govern the collection, use and disclosure of personal data by organisations and to establish the Personal Data Protection Commission and for matters connected therewith.

PART I — PRELIMINARY

This Part sets out the preliminary provisions of the Act including interpretation.

26. Interpretation

"personal data" means data, whether true or not, about an individual who can be identified from that data; or from that data and other information to which the organisation has or is likely to have access.

27. Collection, use and disclosure of personal data

An organisation shall not collect, use or disclose personal data about an individual unless the individual gives, or is deemed to have given, his consent under this Act.

PART II — PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION COMMISSION

This Part establishes the Personal Data Protection Commission and its functions.

5. Establishment of Commission

There is hereby established a Commission to be known as the Personal Data Protection Commission which shall be a body corporate with perpetual succession.
